mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) which are potentiated by corticosteroid-induced mineral wasting; additionally, both agents can cause immunosuppression.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes, calcium, magnesium, and phosphate regularly during concurrent use; ensure adequate supplementation and consider dose adjustment of hydrocortisone if possible.
